closures.id: pilot #4 (standalone VAlignment curve label-group writers) — scope correction
closures.closed_by: not fixed — FINDING recorded: the pilot assessed the 8 standalone curve label groups of Sections-Project-Objects as 'mechanical' writers, but the corpus's records are NOT the empty default-label form the #600 writer emits: after the shared 76-bit class header the records carry 769 bits of real per-label data (values where the compiled template stores zeros, a dragged-position tail, settings, close). A bit-exact writer needs a lossless decode (labels.rs Label keeps only point/offset property values) plus the encoder side of the shared label grammar (labels.rs is read-only today) — a new-writer round of the W1-5/#688 kind. The records DO parse under the shared grammar (header, keyed labels, property-set overrides, settings, B+BS 0x04BE).
